label: Couchbase bucket
type: the persistent bucket type: data is stored on disk as well as cached in memory, supporting replication, durable writes and both storage engines. One of the two bucket types in 8.0.
note:
The default and general-purpose type. In 8.0 the bucket-type set is closed at two members with bucket:ephemeral-bucket - memcached buckets have been removed, a change the buckets page presents as a plain two-type set without noting that a third type ever existed, while the CLI reference still documents the removed type. See docs-issues/server-buckets-page-states-closed-two-type-set-without-noting-removal and server-cli-bucket-compact-cites-removed-memcached-bucket.
